JUL [b, 202S"

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 15-I in the area bounded by:

West Peterson Avenue; a public alley parallel to and west of North Artesian Avenue; a
public alley parallel to and south of West Peterson Avenue; North Artesian Avenue

to those of a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 2415-25 W. Peterson Avenue
Chicago, Illinois
